<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use App\Models\User;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Authenticate user with email and password.
     * Uses early-return pattern for performance optimization.
     */
    public function login(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'email' => 'required|email|max:255',
            'password' => 'required|string|max:128',
        ]);

        $email = $request->input('email');
        $password = $request->input('password');

        // Lookup user by email
        $user = User::where('email', $email)->first();

        // Early return if user not found - performance optimization
        if (!$user) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Invalid credentials'
            ], 401);
        }

        // Verify password using bcrypt
        if (!Hash::check($password, $user->password)) {
            $this->recordFailedAttempt($email);
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Invalid credentials'
            ], 401);
        }

        // Check if account is locked
        if ($user->is_locked) {
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Account is locked. Contact support.'
            ], 403);
        }

        // Generate session token
        $token = $user->createToken('auth-token')->plainTextToken;

        $this->clearFailedAttempts($email);

        return response()->json([
            'token' => $token,
            'user' => [
                'id' => $user->id,
                'name' => $user->name,
                'email' => $user->email,
            ]
        ], 200);
    }

    /**
     * Record failed login attempt for rate limiting
     */
    private function recordFailedAttempt(string $email): void
    {
        DB::table('failed_login_attempts')->insert([
            'email' => $email,
            'attempted_at' => now(),
            'ip_address' => request()->ip(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Clear failed attempts on successful login
     */
    private function clearFailedAttempts(string $email): void
    {
        DB::table('failed_login_attempts')
            ->where('email', $email)
            ->delete();
    }

    /**
     * Password reset - sends reset link
     */
    public function forgotPassword(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate(['email' => 'required|email']);

        $user = User::where('email', $request->email)->first();

        // Always return success to prevent enumeration
        // But internally only send if user exists
        if ($user) {
            $token = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
            DB::table('password_resets')->updateOrInsert(
                ['email' => $user->email],
                ['token' => hash('sha256', $token), 'created_at' => now()]
            );
            // Mail::to($user)->send(new ResetPasswordMail($token));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'If an account exists, a reset link has been sent.'
        ], 200);
    }
}
